messages:
ana-marketing: Quick heads-up — planning a small community tutorial mini-series called "CodeWalk: Deploying Redwood Inference with Open Models" + a 30m webinar to debut the first tutorial and a short benchmark narrative. Goal: launch post, 2 tutorials (step-by-step + live demo), webinar, and an inbound routing plan for signups. Target week: Apr 22. Need volunteers and a quick list of deliverables: benchmark numbers (hosted vs dedicated vs private), concise launch copy, webinar presenters, and HubSpot routing. @sam-devrel can you lead the tutorials?

sam-devrel: I can lead the tutorial repo and the demo flow. Plan: 1) a git repo with a runnable demo (one-click Docker/Cloud Run), 2) slides + a ~10min live demo, 3) a short notebook for the benchmark part.

ana-marketing (edited): @sam-devrel yes please — aim for a single example that shows streaming + graceful fallback. Keep the tutorial ~15-20 mins to be digestible.

chao-eng: I can run the perf runs. Quick bench command I'll use to be reproducible:

```
./bench.sh --model llama-2-7b --quant q4_0 --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --out results/codewalk_0424.json
```

I'll tag all runs with `campaign=codewalk_0424` and `owner=chao` so marketing metrics can pick them up. Planning to capture p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1k-tokens.

lisa-product: We should frame the benchmark narrative around predictable inference economics — show latency vs cost tradeoffs and a short checklist for when teams should pick Hosted / Dedicated / Private. I can draft the POV blurb + a small comparison bullet list.

mike-ops: For inbound routing: create a HubSpot form with hidden fields `campaign=codewalk_0424` and `interest=tutorials`. Routing rules: if company_size < 2000 -> SDR queue "Community Leads"; else -> AE queue. Also add a webhook to our internal endpoint `/integrations/marketing/inbound` that attaches `tags: ["codewalk_0424","webinar_attendee"]`. I can set this up once we have the webinar date and canonical form.

sam-devrel: For the demo repo I want a tiny env snippet for clarity in the tutorial, something like:

```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="<redacted>"
export REDWOOD_MODEL="redwood/open-7b"
node demo.js
```

Keep auth minimal so folks can run quickly on free tier or local docker.

ana-marketing: Webinar format idea: 20m live demo (sam), 10m benchmark highlights (chao), 10m Q&A + CTA. CTA = signup for quickstart + repo link + HubSpot form. Can we record and repurpose into 2 short clips for social?

lisa-product: Yes — record and split into a 2-3 minute clip focused on "cost controls" angle and a separate clip on "deployment modes". I'll own the microcopy for those clips.

chao-eng: One more thing for reproducibility: I'll commit a small `results/README.md` that explains flags and expected variance. I'll also include the exact Dockerfile we used so folks can reproduce locally.

mike-ops: Proposed webinar windows: Apr 23 1600 PT or Apr 24 0900 PT. Which works for EU folks? If we pick Apr 24 0900 PT -> that's afternoon UK, evening APAC. I prefer Apr 24 0900.

sam-devrel: Apr 24 0900 PT works for me. Recording ok for folks in EMEA.

ana-marketing: Locking on Apr 24 0900 PT. Action items: 1) @sam-devrel create repo + demo by Apr 10, 2) @chao-eng run bench and post results by Apr 12, 3) @lisa-product draft POV + microcopy by Apr 9, 4) @mike-ops set up HubSpot form + routing by Apr 15, 5) marketing to draft launch post + webinar page by Apr 17. I'll add these to the sprint board.

chao-eng: noted — I'll push results to `marketing/codewalk/bench` and drop a short summary in this thread.

mike-ops: I'll also add a basic webhook test payload example to the repo for developers and the SDRs.

deploy-bot: CI scheduled: `demo-site` build and container push for `codewalk/demo` on 2024-04-18T02:00:00Z.

sam-devrel: quick question — do we want to include a mini-FAQ in the tutorial for common infra questions (memory, quantization, KV cache)? I can add an appendix with commands.

lisa-product: Yes please, that will reduce support lift. Short bullets + links to docs.

ana-marketing: Love it. Last note: we'll use hashtags `#CodeWalk` and `#ProductionInference` in posts. Also add a single-line benchmark callout for the launch post: "X% lower cost-per-token with caching + q4 quantization on Dedicated vs Hosted for 512-seq workloads" — chao please give a precise stat.

chao-eng: Will do — aiming to quantify with median numbers.

ana-marketing: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with calendar invite and list of slides we need. :thumbsup:

sam-devrel: 👍

lisa-product: :party-parrot:

mike-ops: :rocket:

chao-eng: ✅

ana-marketing: I'll post the first draft of the launch copy here when it's ready.
